def can_form_smaller_string(s, t):

    count_s = Counter(s)
    count_t = Counter(t)
    
    # Iterate over all lowercase English letters
    for char in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz':
        if count_s[char] > 0 and (count_t[char] == 0 or char > min([k for k in count_t.keys() if count_t[k] > 0])):

    return "No"

def can_rearrange(s, t):
    # Count the frequency of each character in both strings
    count_s = Counter(s)
    count_t = Counter(t)
    
    # Find the first character where the counts differ
    for char in sorted(set(count_s.keys()).union(set(count_t.keys()))):
        if count_s[char] > count_t[char]:
            return "No"
        elif count_s[char] < count_t[char]:
            return "Yes"
    
    # If all characters are equal in count, check the total length
    if len(s) <= len(t):
        return "Yes"
    else:
        return "No"

def can_rearrange_to_smaller(s, t):
    # Sort both strings
    s_sorted = sorted(s)
    t_sorted = sorted(t)
    
    # Compare the sorted versions
    return ''.join(s_sorted) < ''.join(t_sorted)
